summary: Frontend testing for Admin/SuperAdmin fixes: Dashboard date validation, Reports active facilities filter, and Emissions override justification fields. All 6 features verified via UI testing.

issues: Minor: Header count sometimes shows inconsistent state during deactivate/activate operations (observed '(2 active)' while cards showed 'Inactive' badges). This appears to be a transient state issue that resolves on page reload.

feature_1_dashboard_end_date_min.description: Dashboard end date month input has 'min' attribute set to start date value
feature_1_dashboard_end_date_min.evidence: Set start date to 2024-06, verified end date min='2024-06'. Updated start to 2024-11, verified min='2024-11'

feature_2_dashboard_end_date_clear.description: When start date changes to be after end date, end date is cleared
feature_2_dashboard_end_date_clear.evidence: Set end date to 2024-09, then changed start to 2024-11. End date value cleared to ''

feature_3_reports_active_facilities.description: Reports page only shows active facilities (is_active !== false filter)
feature_3_reports_active_facilities.evidence: When test-2 was inactive, Reports showed only test-1. When both active, shows '2 of 2 facilities selected'. When both inactive, showed 'No facilities available'

feature_4_emissions_calorific_justificat.description: Override Calorific Value shows justification input field
feature_4_emissions_calorific_justificat.evidence: Found input with placeholder 'Justification for override (required) *'

feature_5_emissions_density_justificatio.description: Override Density shows justification input field
feature_5_emissions_density_justificatio.evidence: Found input with placeholder 'Justification for override (required) *'

feature_6_emissions_justification_valida.description: Form submission validates justification when override is enabled
feature_6_emissions_justification_valida.evidence: Submitted form with override enabled but no justification - received toast error 'Justification is required when overriding Calorific Value'

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Dashboard.js line 202 - End date has min={dateRange.from ? format(dateRange.from, 'yyyy-MM') : undefined}
GOOD: Dashboard.js lines 183-190 - onChange for start date clears end date if it's before new start
GOOD: Reports.js line 34 - fetchFacilities filters with f.is_active !== false
GOOD: Emissions.js line 1477 - Calorific value justification placeholder 'Justification for override (required) *'
GOOD: Emissions.js line 1540 - Density justification placeholder 'Justification for override (required) *'
GOOD: Emissions.js lines 758-765 - handleSubmit validates justification with toast.error
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test data. Both facilities (test-1, test-2) were temporarily deactivated during testing and then reactivated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 admin/superadmin fixes verified: Dashboard date validation (min attribute + clearing), Reports active facility filter, Emissions override justification fields and validation. Both test facilities are now active. Previous iteration_31 also passed similar features.
